name: Can a side-house addition include an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)?

mainEntity.name: Can a side-house addition include an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a side-house addition can be designed to include an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), provided it meets local zoning and building code requirements for ADUs. This offers an excellent opportunity to create a separate living space for family members, guests, or as a rental income source. Designing an ADU within an addition requires careful planning for independent access, kitchenettes, bathrooms, and utility hookups, aligning with specific ADU regulations in your municipality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a side-house addition can include an ADU if it meets local zoning and building codes, offering a separate living space for family or rental income.
